## Purpose

Describe the workflow, failure mode, or maintenance need addressed by this
change.

## Safety and evidence

- [ ] No secrets, private inventory, addresses, identifiers, or raw host output
      are included.
- [ ] Trigger conditions, non-goals, authority boundaries, and failure behavior
      remain explicit.
- [ ] Deterministic behavior has tests or a documented reason why it cannot.
- [ ] Installation, upgrade, rollback, or compatibility impact is documented.
- [ ] `./scripts/validate.sh` passes.

## Validation

List the commands, fixtures, and environments used. State what remains
unverified.
